sentences.text: Dungeons & Dragons -LRB- abbreviated as D&D or DnD -RRB- is a fantasy tabletop role-playing game -LRB- RPG -RRB- originally designed by Gary Gygax and Dave Arneson , and first published in 1974 by Tactical Studies Rules , Inc. -LRB- TSR -RRB- .	Gary Gygax	Gary Gygax	Dave Arneson	Dave Arneson	TSR	TSR (company)	fantasy	fantasy	tabletop role-playing game	tabletop role-playing game	Dungeons & Dragons	Editions of Dungeons & Dragons#Dungeons & Dragons, or the Basic Set and its sequels
The game has been published by Wizards of the Coast -LRB- now a subsidiary of Hasbro -RRB- since 1997 .	Wizards of the Coast	Wizards of the Coast	Hasbro	Hasbro
It was derived from miniature wargames with a variation of the Chainmail game serving as the initial rule system .	miniature wargames	miniature wargaming	Chainmail	chainmail (game)
D&D publication is commonly recognized as the beginning of modern role-playing games and the role-playing game industry .

D&D departs from traditional wargaming and assigns each player a specific character to play instead of a military formation .	wargaming	wargaming	character	Player character	military formation	military formation
These characters embark upon imaginary adventures within a fantasy setting .	fantasy	fantasy	setting	setting (narrative)

A Dungeon Master serves as the game 's referee and storyteller , while maintaining the setting in which the adventures occur and playing the role of the inhabitants .	setting	setting (narrative)	Dungeon Master	Dungeon Master
The characters form a party that interacts with the setting 's inhabitants -LRB- and each other -RRB- .	setting	setting (narrative)
Together they solve dilemmas , engage in battles and gather treasure and knowledge .
In the process the characters earn experience points to become increasingly powerful over a series of sessions .	experience points	experience points
The early success of Dungeons & Dragons led to a proliferation of similar game systems .	Dungeons & Dragons	Editions of Dungeons & Dragons#Dungeons & Dragons, or the Basic Set and its sequels
Despite this competition , D&D remains the market leader in the role-playing game industry .

In 1977 , the game was split into two branches : the relatively rules-light game system of Dungeons & Dragons and the more structured , rules-heavy game system of Advanced Dungeons & Dragons -LRB- abbreviated as AD&D or ADnD -RRB- .	AD&D	Advanced Dungeons & Dragons	Dungeons & Dragons	Editions of Dungeons & Dragons#Dungeons & Dragons, or the Basic Set and its sequels	Advanced Dungeons & Dragons	Editions of Dungeons & Dragons#Advanced Dungeons & Dragons
AD&D 2nd Edition was published in 1989 .	AD&D	Advanced Dungeons & Dragons

In 2000 , the original line of the game was discontinued and the AD&D version was renamed Dungeons & Dragons with the release of its 3rd edition with a new system .	original	Dungeons & Dragons (1974)	AD&D	Advanced Dungeons & Dragons	Dungeons & Dragons	Editions of Dungeons & Dragons#Dungeons & Dragons, or the Basic Set and its sequels
These rules formed the basis of the d20 System which is available under the Open Game License -LRB- OGL -RRB- for use by other publishers .	d20 System	d20 System	Open Game License	Open Game License

Dungeons & Dragons version 3.5 was released in June 2003 , with a -LRB- non-OGL -RRB- 4th edition in June 2008 .	Dungeons & Dragons	Editions of Dungeons & Dragons#Dungeons & Dragons, or the Basic Set and its sequels
A 5th edition was released during the second half of 2014 .

, Dungeons & Dragons remained the best-known and best-selling role-playing game , with an estimated 20 million people having played the game and more than US$ 1 billion in book and equipment sales .	Dungeons & Dragons	Editions of Dungeons & Dragons#Dungeons & Dragons, or the Basic Set and its sequels

The game has been supplemented by many pre-made adventures as well as commercial campaign settings suitable for use by regular gaming groups .	pre-made adventures	Adventure (Dungeons & Dragons)	campaign settings	Dungeons & Dragons campaign settings

Dungeons & Dragons is known beyond the game for other D&D - branded products , references in popular culture , and some of the controversies that have surrounded it , particularly a moral panic in the 1980s falsely linking it to Satanism and suicide . The game has won multiple awards and has been translated into many languages beyond the original English .	original	Dungeons & Dragons (1974)
